verdict.rationale: An OpenAPI spec exists (mem0-probe-2) and quickstart docs show runnable code snippets like client.add() in Python/JS (mem0-docs-25, mem0-docs-35), suggesting API documentation with examples, but there is no evidence of an interactive reference (e.g., a Swagger/Redoc UI or embedded 'try it' console) that lets users execute calls directly in the browser. missing for 10: confirmation of an interactive API explorer/playground, evidence of in-browser runnable request execution, independent user confirmation of using such a feature.
